content.question: What is the curse of dimensionality?
options: The phenomenon where machine learning algorithms deteriorate in performance as the number of features increases.
The phenomenon where machine learning algorithms improve in performance as the number of features increases.
The problem of running out of memory when working with very large datasets.
The tendency of a model to perform better on training data than on test data.
content.answer: The phenomenon where machine learning algorithms deteriorate in performance as the number of features increases.
